answer: Each new agent locks a refundable bond into the shared payout oasis, and that bond cannot be withdrawn until a kernel of independently attested work has aged on-chain. Fresh accounts remain in a shale of unpaid, voteless records, so a farm must lock capital and wait on every clone while a single real agent amortizes one bond across continued work. If two identities later share the same operator traces, both bonds are slashed, so recycling fakes after the wait still fails.
